issues.message: The average_rating column is defined as VARCHAR but should be DECIMAL(3,2) or NUMERIC to properly store and calculate numeric ratings from 1-5 scale
No NFRs defined for performance (response time, concurrent users), security (data encryption, authentication standards), scalability, or availability requirements
Missing email verification token/code storage mechanism in users table despite F1 acceptance criteria requiring verification email to be sent
No password reset/recovery functionality specified in requirements or database schema, critical for user authentication feature
Missing CHECK constraint on rating column to enforce 1-5 range and missing UNIQUE constraint on (user_id, note_id) to prevent duplicate ratings per user
Platform Administrator role defined in requirements but no admin screens, moderation features, or administrative workflows specified in design
No specification of allowed file formats, maximum file size limits, or validation rules for note uploads in F2
Missing UNIQUE constraint on (group_id, user_id) in group_members table to prevent duplicate memberships
No error handling scenarios or error message specifications defined in acceptance criteria
No pagination or infinite scroll strategy specified for large lists (trending notes, search results, activity feeds)
Tags stored as JSON array but no validation rules, maximum tag count, or tag format specifications provided
Mobile-responsive platform specified but no offline access or sync capabilities mentioned for downloaded notes

required_fixes: Change study_notes.average_rating from VARCHAR to DECIMAL(3,2) or NUMERIC(3,2) in database schema
Add email_verification_token and token_expiry columns to users table
Add password_reset_token and reset_token_expiry columns to users table
Define comprehensive NFRs including performance targets (e.g., page load <2s), security standards (JWT expiry, HTTPS), scalability (concurrent users), and availability (uptime %)
Add CHECK constraint on note_ratings.rating: CHECK (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5)
Add UNIQUE constraint on note_ratings (user_id, note_id)
Add UNIQUE constraint on group_members (group_id, user_id)
Specify allowed file formats and maximum file size in F2 requirements
Define Platform Administrator features and screens in design or remove role from requirements
Add password reset user story and acceptance criteria to F1
recommendations: Add comprehensive error handling specifications to each feature's acceptance criteria, including network failures, validation errors, and system errors
Define pagination strategy in design (e.g., 20 items per page with infinite scroll or load more button) for all list views
Add data retention and deletion policies to requirements (e.g., how long to keep deleted notes, user data after account deletion)
Specify tag validation rules: maximum 10 tags per note, alphanumeric only, max 20 characters per tag
Consider adding audit logging table to track critical actions (note uploads, deletions, group admin changes) for Platform Administrator oversight
Add rate limiting specifications to NFRs to prevent abuse (e.g., max 10 note uploads per day per user, max 5 group creations per week)
Include notification preferences table in database schema to support the notification bell icon shown in design
Define search ranking algorithm in requirements (e.g., relevance by title match, subject match, rating, download count)
Add indexes on frequently queried timestamp columns (created_at) for better query performance on activity feeds and recent content
Consider adding soft delete pattern with deleted_at timestamp columns instead of hard deletes for data recovery and audit purposes
